fields.title: Lock released before async save completes
fields.selector: Does the change release a lock, semaphore or mutex before an awaited persistence call completes?
fields.prompt:
Look for a lock release that runs before an awaited save. Judge whether a second writer can
enter while the save is in flight.
fields.humans: Releasing a lock before the save completes lets two writers interleave.
fields.rationale: Missed in review twice in 2026 (order lock, invoice lock).

rows: the lock was released one line too early

fields.description: OrderSaver released the lock before SaveChangesAsync completed.

rows: Lock helpers explain the release contract
